summary: Describes version 2 of KeyNote, a trust-management system. It specifies the syntax and meaning of assertions, how action attributes are processed, and the application architecture a KeyNote implementation fits into. It lets policy and credentials decide whether an action is allowed. This is an informational memo.

eli5.summary: Instead of asking who you are, KeyNote asks whether a signed note says you may do this. It is like a permission slip that the guard checks.
